content_sections.heading: BSV Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: There are a total of 12 vacancies across various guest faculty and accompanist disciplines. The distribution of vacancies is detailed below:

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: For Guest Accompanist posts (Sl. No. 05 to 07): Minimum age is 18 years and maximum age is 35 years. For Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), and Other Backward Classes (OBC) category candidates, a 5-year age relaxation is applicable.

rows.category: Scheduled Caste (SC) / Scheduled Tribe (ST) / Other Backward Classes (OBC)

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Filled application form with passport size self-attested photograph affixed. High school marks sheet for age proof. Aadhar card. All original educational and essential certificates and mark sheets. Self-attested copies of all required certificates and documents. SC/ST/OBC/EWS category certificate, if applicable.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates can submit their filled application form with self-attested copies of documents to the office by 12:00 PM on 05 November 2026, or appear in person directly at the interview in the university office on the same day at 12:00 PM along with their original certificates and essential documents. For serial numbers 05 to 07 (Guest Accompanists), a mandatory practical demonstration test will be conducted.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Selection for serial numbers 01 to 03 will be based purely on merit and UGC guidelines. For postgraduate specializations, if a degree in specialization was obtained in any subject, a degree in that same subject will be considered valid. Example: In music, specialization in vocal is not considered valid for instrumental. Demonstration is mandatory for candidates appearing for guest accompanist posts (Sl. No. 05 to 07). The appointment is entirely temporary and services can be terminated at any time without prior notice based on necessity. In case of any dispute, the decision of the university will be final.

faq.question: Q1. What is the date for the BSV walk-in interview 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 05 November 2026 at 12:00 PM.

faq.question: Q2. What is the venue for the BSV guest faculty interview?
faq.answer: The interview will take place at the office of Bhatkhande Sanskriti Vishwavidyalaya, Lucknow.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 12 vacancies for guest faculty and accompanist positions.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Guest Accompanist posts?
faq.answer: The age limit for Guest Accompanist posts (Sl. No. 05 to 07) is a minimum of 18 years and maximum of 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any age relaxation provided?
faq.answer: Yes, a 5-year age relaxation is given to candidates belonging to SC, ST, and OBC (non-creamy layer) categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification required for Guest Faculty in Computer Science?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed M.Tech / MCA or an equivalent examination with two years of working experience.

faq.question: Q7. What documents need to be brought to the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring a filled application form, high school mark sheet for age proof, Aadhar card, self-attested copies of all required certificates and mark sheets, category certificate (if applicable), and all original educational and supporting certificates.

faq.question: Q8. Are guest accompanist candidates required to give a demonstration?
faq.answer: Yes, a performance demonstration is mandatory for candidates applying for guest accompanist positions (Sl. No. 05 to 07).
